name: Grade Release Confirmation (Staff)
description: Confirmation email sent to the grader after a student grade has been released, so the staff member has a record that the student was notified.
subject: Grade Sent: $assignment_title — $student_id
body_text:
Hi $staff_name,

You have successfully released a grade for:

- Student: $student_id ($student_name)
- Assignment: $assignment_title
- Module: $module_code
- Grade: $grade_display

The student has been notified by email at $student_email.

$signature
body_html:
